test_policy.notes: Submitting SAT or ACT scores is optional for first-year applicants, including international applicants. Official scores can be sent with CEEB code 002520 (SAT) or ACT code 2572.

requirements.notes: Apply with the Montclair State application or the Common App; $65 non-refundable fee (fee waivers are need-based). International first-year applicants submit secondary transcripts (certified English translation), an essay/personal statement (prompts vary by major), and English proficiency scores if not exempt. A recommendation letter from a counselor or teacher is strongly encouraged but not required for most majors (Dance, Musical Theatre and Theatre require two). Nursing needs a nursing-specific essay and extra recommendations; some College of the Arts programs require auditions or portfolios. Admission is rolling.

deadlines.label: Early Action, international (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Decisions released by Dec. 24, 2026 (College of the Arts applicants may hear later because of audition/portfolio review). The page encourages early application for scholarship consideration.

deadlines.label: Final international application deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Suggested deadline for students outside the U.S.; students already in the U.S. may have more flexibility. Decisions typically 3-6 weeks after the application is complete. The page's January-start (spring) line prints 'November 1, 2027', which is not used here.

deadlines.label: I-20 application deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: I-20 is issued within 5-10 business days after a complete I-20 application.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived for U.S. citizens and for students who graduated from (or attended an international school following the system of) the United States or a listed English-speaking country (e.g. Australia, Canada except Quebec, Ireland, Jamaica, Nigeria, South Africa, United Kingdom). Other accepted proof: iTEP 3.7, SAT EBRW 480+, or ACT English 22+. The page lists no ESL or conditional-admission pathway for first-year applicants.

english.notes: 'Old version' of the TOEFL iBT. School code 2520.
'New version' minimum 4.0; the page does not name the 1-6 scale.

cost.notes: Out-of-state on-campus estimate for 2026-27 (international F-1/J-1 students pay out-of-state tuition): tuition $27,924, fees $1,222, housing $10,838, food $6,612, books $1,330, travel $1,380, miscellaneous $2,430, loan fee $72 (total $51,808). In-state tuition is $16,588.

aid.notes: Montclair cannot offer need-based aid to international students. Qualified first-year international students are automatically awarded the renewable (up to four years) Presidential Scholarship based on GPA criteria; the amount and GPA cutoffs are not published (details are given upon acceptance). Talent-based performing arts awards are also open to international students.

majors.notes: Separate Feb. 1 application deadline for international applicants, nursing-specific essay and extra recommendations.

majors.program: Performing arts (Dance, Music, Music Therapy, Musical Theatre, Theatre)
majors.notes: Audition and audition fee; a resume is required for Dance, Musical Theatre and Theatre, which also need two recommendation letters.
